business_risk_description: User can create a fictitious vendor and then run the payment that pays that same vendor - classic fraud pattern (fake vendor scheme).
User can alter vendor bank details and then post an outgoing payment - enables payment diversion fraud.
User can create a purchase order and then record its own goods receipt - can confirm goods that were never actually received.
User can record goods receipt and also process the vendor invoice - can approve invoices for goods that were never received.
User can post manual journal entries and also perform bank reconciliation - can post a fraudulent entry and hide it during reconciliation.
User can create/modify user accounts and also design roles - can grant themselves any access in the system with no independent oversight.
User can change employee master data (e.g. bank account, salary) and also execute the payroll run - enables payroll fraud.
